what_i_changed: Added `EvidenceFailureFallback`, which snapshots the supplied reader’s advertised names and emits valueless ABSENT evidence items. `execute()` now uses it when category evidence reading throws, while retaining the existing category/read failure record and degraded classification.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: This uses a dedicated fallback component in the existing category module rather than extending `absent_evidence()` with a reader parameter. Verified with the acceptance test and full suite: 319 passed, 3 skipped.
